notes: Wave 1 of the 30-keyword birthday set. Ranks 2 and 3 of the shortlist (birthday date personality test, birthday decoration ideas at home) were HELD, not written: Phase 0 found no first-party data for numerology or physical decoration and no first-hand experience to substitute, so the blocking gate was respected. Ranks 11 and 12 (birthday wishes in hindi, 2 line birthday wishes) were substituted in. birthday-wishes-in-hindi is a HUB absorbing three keywords whose SERPs overlap by 3+ results: janamdin ki hardik shubhkamnaye, birthday quotes in hindi, birthday wishes for brother in hindi — do not write those separately.

publishBlockers.detail: Every Devanagari, Tamil, Gujarati and Telugu string is machine-generated and unverified. Each post records this as a STRUCTURAL audit failure. Telugu's and Tamil's are explicitly marked not closable by adding a citation. what-to-write-on-a-birthday-cake also contains Devanagari and Tamil examples.

168 birthday posts are already live and none appeared in any of the 60 India SERPs harvested for this run. Striking-distance or indexing cannot be distinguished without a GSC export, and that determines whether these 10 land in the same hole.

publishBlockers.issue: Phase 1 competitor pages not individually fetched
publishBlockers.detail: WebSearch hit its 200/200 session cap. SERPs were harvested with a real browser at gl=in and supplied to each agent, but most top-5 pages were not fetched in full. Recorded per-post in the research briefs.

firstPartyData.headline: median personal message 96 characters; 106 of 197 under 100
firstPartyData.caveat: n=198 from 2026-04; no language or relationship field exists, so no per-language or per-relation claim is possible
